On no match it sets waiting without a future due_at, making the same paid research eligible on each natural run. SERP snippet alone cannot prove source freshness or authorize an email.
fix: Reuse exact existing original research Edge with pure candidate validator. On matched organic result, independently compare original action_id, person_key, company_key, status PREPARED, source hold gate, and updated_at CAS; append only relationship_source_candidate with source and origin lineage marked UNVERIFIED, never public_source_evidence, source_url, approved plan, provider permissions or sent status. On no result, move same internal research action due_at 24h later using existing queue, same scheduler. Owner-only Andere data shows aggregated waiting no signal, candidate still unverified, next original retry and actual Gmail readbacks as separate counters.

An empty original bounded search must have a bounded next natural due_at, no extra cron, cost blow-up or fake green. Link all evidence to existing original action with CAS and no personal leak to portal.
